sources.title: Chungulus/Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder-Q6_K-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder - Q6_K Q6_K GGUF of CCORE's original FP16 checkpoint, quantized independently from its full-precision export. The upstream checkpoint has 4,539,265,536 parameters including vision; this text GGUF has 4,205,751,296 parameters. The unchanged upstream BF16 vision projector is included. This is a community quantization of CCORE's fine-tune, not an official Qwen or CCORE release.
